description: Alphabet Inc. is a collection of businesses, the largest of which is Google, and has been an AI-first company since 2016, having pioneered the development of artificial intelligence and continuing to develop frontier models that serve its businesses. It reports Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, with all non-Google businesses collectively reported as Other Bets, and supports these businesses with centralized AI-related research and development reported in Alphabet-level activities. Google generates revenue from advertising across search, YouTube and other properties as well as from products and subscriptions sold directly to consumers and businesses, and Google Cloud provides cloud products and services to customers of all sizes.
